analyzed_vuln.description: Heap buffer overflow is caused by ASN.1 template decoding storing INTEGER values into mp_int without validating that the ASN INTEGER length fits the destination mp_int capacity. In GetASN_StoreData(), ASN_DATA_TYPE_MP calls mp_read_unsigned_bin(data->data.mp, input+idx, len). Under SP math this resolves to sp_read_unsigned_bin(), which sets a->used from len and writes a->dp[j] words; if len exceeds allocated mp_int size, writes go past the heap buffer (crash at sp_int.c:17303).
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Triggered via ECDSA verify path: cryptofuzz passes attacker-controlled DER signature to wc_ecc_verify_hash() -> DecodeECC_DSA_Sig() (ASN template path) -> GetASN_Items()/GetASN_StoreData(). A malformed signature with oversized r or s INTEGER length causes mp_read_unsigned_bin on fixed-size r/s mp_int allocated from ECC_KEY_MAX_BITS(key), leading to out-of-bounds write when ASN length is larger than that capacity.
